title: Monty Hall: Let's Fake a Deal
content: The host randomly opens an unchosen door without consulting the car location. Door Opened therefore has only Your Door as a cause, and observing it cannot associate Your Door with Location of Car.

variables.name: Location of Car
variables.content: The independently chosen and causally isolated location of the car.

variables.name: Door Opened
variables.content: The randomly selected unchosen door opened by the host.

arrows.because: The host still must open a door different from the contestant's choice.
